gapRules.message: People who sign in will need to reset a forgotten password.
Sign up usually comes with a login screen.
Sign-ups often verify an email or phone number.
The App Store and Google Play require apps with sign-up to offer account deletion in the app.
Profiles usually link to account settings.
A cart usually leads to a checkout flow.
Checkout needs a way to add and choose payment methods.
Customers expect to track an order after checkout.
In-app notifications usually have matching push notifications.
Every data screen needs empty, error and offline states.
Multi-language apps need a language selector.
Supporting Arabic, Hebrew or Urdu? Right-to-left layouts need extra design time.
